title: Invoice status update refactored to a single fill()/save()
description: Three attribute assignments are collapsed into fill()/save(). Behaviour, authorisation and validation are unchanged.
context: Invoice::$fillable includes both status and paid_at, so fill() will not silently discard either value. The authorize() call and InvoicePolicy are unchanged and visible as context lines in the diff.
notes: Clean control. 'status' and 'paid_at' are on the model's $fillable list and the values are literals, so fill() introduces no mass-assignment exposure. Any finding reported here counts as a false positive.
